test_do_fft_1D: test the do_fft function on 1D signals to verify FFT magnitude at known frequencies
test_do_fft_multidimensional: test the do_fft function on 2D and 3D arrays along a specified axis
test_filter_impulse_response: test the filter_impulse_response function for both IIR SOS and FIR coefficient filters
